description: Session-day event tags for iap.validation.sessions (v1.13, R-P2-9). fomc = scheduled FOMC statement (second, decision) day. holiday_thin = NYSE 1:00 pm early closes plus the platform's convention of the trading days between Christmas and New Year. A year missing here is not covered: iap.validation.sessions.event_calendar_for_year refuses it (fail closed).

source.fomc: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomchistorical2019.htm (scheduled meetings; the 2019-10-04 conference call is unscheduled and not tagged)
source.holiday_thin: early closes 2019-07-03, 2019-11-29, 2019-12-24 per the NYSE holiday calendar of that year (no longer on nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, which lists 2026-2028; not re-verified); 2019-12-26..31 by convention

source.fomc: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomchistorical2020.htm (scheduled meetings; 2020-03-17/18 cancelled; unscheduled meetings and notation votes not tagged)
source.holiday_thin: early closes 2020-11-27, 2020-12-24 per the NYSE holiday calendar of that year (not on the current nyse.com page; not re-verified); 2020-12-28..31 by convention

early close 2021-11-26 per the NYSE holiday calendar of that year (2021-12-24 was a full holiday; not on the current nyse.com page; not re-verified); 2021-12-27..31 by convention; 2021-07-02 and 2021-12-23 by convention (trading day before a full market holiday: 2021-07-05 observed Independence Day, 2021-12-24 Christmas), not exchange early closes
early closes 2025-07-03, 2025-11-28, 2025-12-24 per the NYSE 2025 holiday calendar (no longer on nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars; not re-verified); 2025-12-26..31 by convention

early closes 2026-11-27, 2026-12-24 verified on https://www.nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars 2026-10-11; 2026-07-02 (eve of the 2026-07-03 observed holiday) is NOT an NYSE early close and is kept as a platform convention; 2026-12-28..31 by convention
